summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing the September 14, 2026 termination of its November 2024 collaboration with Novo Nordisk A/S covering TransCon technology-based products in metabolic and cardiovascular diseases, including obesity. All licenses granted to Novo Nordisk, notably for once-monthly TransCon Semaglutide, revert to Ascendis, and neither party retains continuing financial obligations. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The mechanics are a straight contractual unwind rather than a monetization, with no regulatory clock or financing condition. Watch for redeployment of the reacquired asset, potential re-partnering, and any impairment or disclosure of foregone milestones as risk-arb considerations.
